Meri Baby Prachi ke naam 💌

Dear Baby,

Meri zindagi mein aane ke liye thank you. Pata nahi tumne kaise, lekin meri aam-si duniya mein bahut saari khushiyan bhar di. Tumhari smile, tumhari baatein aur tumhare chhote-chhote nakhre bhi mere liye bahut khaas hain.

Main yeh nahi kahunga ki har din perfect hoga, lekin itna zaroor chahta hoon ki jab bhi din mushkil ho, hum ek-doosre ko samajhne ki koshish karein. Tumhe hasaane ki koshish karoon, tumhari baat sunoon aur tumhe yeh mehsoos karaoon ki tum mere liye bahut maayne rakhti ho.

Thank you, Baby, meri kahaani ka itna pyaara hissa banne ke liye. Tumhari smile hamesha bani rahe—and agar kabhi wajah kam pade, toh main apni bewakoofi se kaam chala loonga. ❤️

Bahut saara pyaar,
tumhara apna ❤️

Breaking News 📰

Prachi ki smile itni pyaari hai ki use dekhkar mera dimaag do kaam karta hai:

1. Dil bolta hai: “Awww, meri Baby!” 💗
2. Dimaag bolta hai: “Bhai, ab kuch mat bolna… pichhli baar bhi zyada bolkar phansa tha!” 😂

Aur agar kabhi tum mujhse naraaz ho jao, toh main tumhe manaane ke liye taiyaar hoon… bas ek chhoti-si request hai—meri saza mein khaana band mat karwana! 🍕😭

Kyunki main tumse bahut pyaar karta hoon… aur pizza se bhi thoda-sa. Lekin tumse zyada, obviously! 😌❤️

Ab ek pyaari-si smile de do, Baby. Yeh website banaane wale bechaare ko bhi thodi tareef milni chahiye! 🥹🌸
